arguments.value: Judge Louise W. Flanagan, born in 1962 in Richmond, Virginia, serves on the U.S. District Court for the Eastern District of North Carolina, where she was nominated by President George W. Bush in 2003 and previously served as a U.S. magistrate judge from 1995 to 2003. She earned her B.A. from Wake Forest University in 1984 and her J.D. from the University of Virginia School of Law in 1988. Earlier in her career, she clerked for Judge Malcolm J. Howard of the U.S. District Court for the Eastern District of North Carolina and practiced law in Washington, D.C., and Greenville, North Carolina.
